recommendations.proposed_negotiation_guidance: Open at 30 days as the preferred position, since the 45-day ask has been conceded in 6 of 8 past decisions. If counterparty pushes back, consider whether any further concession is warranted on a case-by-case basis and escalate accordingly.
recommendations.rationale: The preferred position of 45 days was conceded 6 of 8 times (2 accepted at preferred, 4 accepted_fallback at 30 days, 2 rejected). The organization consistently settled at the 30-day fallback, indicating the 45-day preferred position is stricter than what is realistically achieved in negotiations. Aligning the preferred position to 30 days would reflect actual practice. Note: this change makes the organization LESS protected, as it removes the buffer of negotiating from a more favorable starting point. A lawyer should review before adopting.
